title: Name the discount
prompt: Parts are 25% off. Name the 0.25 `DISCOUNT` and use it to work out the sale price.
starter:
func solve(price) -> float:
	return price - price * 0.25
hints: 25% as a decimal is the number to name.

docs.name: const NAME = value
docs.what: Declares a named value that never changes. Written in CAPITALS by convention.
